title: Private audio track-reference delete integrity
purpose: Prevent destructive private-audio deletion from creating dangling SeshTrack.audioAssetIds references before track-audio attachment authority is introduced.

canonicalRelationship.projectAudioAssetIds: Canonical inventory of private audio assets attached to the project.
canonicalRelationship.trackAudioAssetIds: Organizational subset of project audio assigned to a track.
canonicalRelationship.deleteInvariant: An audio asset referenced by any track in its canonical project cannot be destructively deleted until every track reference has been removed.

deleteOrder: Read and recheck the canonical project snapshot.
Read and recheck canonical audio metadata and project membership.
Fail with conflict if any track references the audio asset.
Only then detach audio from project through project CAS.
Only after project detachment delete audio metadata.
Only after metadata deletion delete private R2 bytes.

failureSemantics.trackListFailure: Fail closed as unavailable before any destructive mutation.
failureSemantics.referencedByTrack: Return conflict before project, metadata, or binary mutation.

authority.projectMutation: Existing audio delete lifecycle only after reference guard passes.

canonicalMembershipFixForward.metadataListingPurpose: Integrity read only; project-scoped track metadata does not itself establish canonical attachment.
